description: Prospective untouched formal held-out sources for a future frozen v9 live tool/LLM experiment. These 80 sources were selected and frozen offline before any v9 execution, without network access or inspection of performance artifacts, and are disjoint from every development, tuning, frozen-development, frozen-tuning, and formal-v2 through formal-v8 source. Each authoritative Wikipedia visit URL was committed before execution; this split must use exactly one replica per source and must not be inspected for tuning, load selection, or parameter selection.
